note: Furnas County publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (Zoning-Map_SizeE.pdf) and zoning regulations as a PDF. The county site links no ArcGIS REST zoning service. Its gworks parcel viewer (furnas.gworks.com) exposes no discoverable REST services directory (probe returned 404), and gis2.gworks.com has no Furnas PZ or zoning service. ArcGIS search for Furnas zoning returned no district layer. No city layer for Cambridge, Arapahoe, Beaver City or Holbrook was found either.
